decision.description:
Validation statuses.

`imei` validation statuses with which the supply can be transferred to delivery: - `filled` — Label identifier is added to the assembly order, validation is not required - `deadlineExceeded` — Label identifier validation is not completed and will continue. The validation can pass or fail - `optional` — Label identifier is not required. Validation passed - `imeiMaySell` — The item is approved for sale. Validation passed - `imeiSoldB2B` — The item was sold to a B2B buyer and approved for sale again. Validation passed

`imei` validation statuses with which the supply can not be transferred to delivery: - `pending` — Label identifier validation continues. Wait for the validation status to change - `required` — Required label identifier is not added to the assembly order. Validation failed - `imeiInvalidFormat` — Invalid format. Validation failed - `imeiAlreadySold` — The item with this IMEI has already been sold. Validation failed

`uin` validation statuses with which the supply can be transferred to delivery: - `filled` — Label identifier is added to the assembly order, validation is not required - `deadlineExceeded` — Label identifier validation is not completed and will continue. Wait for the validation status to change - `required` — Required label identifier is not added to the assembly order. Validation failed - `uinInvalidFormat` — Invalid format. Validation failed - `uinBadStatus` — Invalid batch status. Validation failed - `uinBadProcess` — Invalid processing stage. Validation failed - `uinBadStatusAndBadProcess` — Invalid batch status. Invalid processing stage. Validation failed - `uinNotFound` — Not found in GIIS DMDK. Validation failed. The status may mean that the UIN: - is not specified in the uploaded Delivery Contract Specification - is not registered in GIIS DMDK - is specified incorrectly and is read from the tag with errors - is not in circulation

patch.description:
Closes the supply and moves all assembly orders to `complete` (`In Delivery`) status. You cannot add any assembly orders to the supply after it is closed. If the supply wasn't handed over for delivery, than scanning its QR code or accepting the first item will automatically close the supply. You can transfer the supply to delivery only if: - there is at least one assembly order - required labeling is specified for all assembly orders - labeling of all assembly orders passed validation If the supply contains assembly orders with required UIN, make sure that you have created and uploaded the Delivery Contract Specification in advance. The [GIIS DMDK](https://minfin.gov.ru/ru/perfomance/jewels/dmdk) takes about 30 minutes to process changes in UIN statuses. It is required to [specify the shipping parameters](/openapi/orders-fbs#tag/fbsSupplies/operation/patchV3FbsSuppliesShippingMethod) for supplies from Russian sellers to Russia shipping points. If the shipping method, shipping date, or shipping point is not specified, a `409` error is returned.
